title: Detailed snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='globeShine' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e6ff' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#5bb8e8' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a7ab5' stop-opacity='0.05'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='globeDome' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8f0ff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='85%' stop-color='#6ec6f0' stop-opacity='0.12'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4aa8d8' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='32' ry='7' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <rect x='18' y='70' width='64' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e8b830'/>
  <rect x='18' y='70' width='64' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f5d050'/>
  <rect x='20' y='74' width='60' height='2' fill='#d4a010' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Base decorative band -->
  <rect x='20' y='76' width='60' height='2' fill='#d4a010' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#f5d050'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='3' fill='#e8b830'/>

  <!-- Globe sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='32' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='32' fill='url(#globeDome)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='32' fill='url(#globeShine)'/>

  <!-- Snowy ground inside globe -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='8' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='66' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#e8f4ff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Small pine tree left -->
  <rect x='34' y='60' width='3' height='7' fill='#6b4226'/>
  <polygon points='35.5,48 28,62 43,62' fill='#1e7a3a'/>
  <polygon points='35.5,52 30,61 41,61' fill='#2a9a4a'/>
  <polygon points='35.5,56 31,61 40,61' fill='#35b85a'/>
  <!-- Snow on tree -->
  <ellipse cx='35.5' cy='50' rx='4' ry='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Small pine tree right -->
  <rect x='62' y='58' width='3' height='8' fill='#6b4226'/>
  <polygon points='63.5,46 55,61 72,61' fill='#1e7a3a'/>
  <polygon points='63.5,50 57,60 70,60' fill='#2a9a4a'/>
  <polygon points='63.5,54 58,60 69,60' fill='#35b85a'/>
  <ellipse cx='63.5' cy='48' rx='5' ry='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Little snowman center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='5' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snowman eyes -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='49.5' r='0.6' fill='#2a5a8a'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='49.5' r='0.6' fill='#2a5a8a'/>
  <!-- Snowman nose -->
  <polygon points='50,50.5 52,51 50,51.5' fill='#ff8c00'/>
  <!-- Snowman buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='0.5' fill='#4a8ab5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='0.5' fill='#4a8ab5'/>
  <!-- Snowman scarf -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='52' width='5' height='1.2' rx='0.5' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <rect x='52' y='52' width='1.5' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <!-- Snowman hat -->
  <rect x='48' y='47' width='4' height='1.5' fill='#2a5a8a'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='48.5' width='3' height='1' fill='#2a5a8a'/>

  <!-- Small house in background -->
  <rect x='42' y='60' width='6' height='5' fill='#c06030'/>
  <polygon points='40,60 45,55 50,60' fill='#e87040'/>
  <rect x='43.5' y='62' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <rect x='46' y='61.5' width='1.5' height='1.5' fill='#ffe060'/>

  <!-- Falling snow dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='25' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='22' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='45' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='38' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='18' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='55' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='30' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Globe highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.12' transform='rotate(-30 38 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='30' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.18' transform='rotate(-30 36 30)'/>
</svg>
